hook.name: CleaveV4Hook
hook.description: A reflection-buyback hook that collects a 0.7% fee on both buys (ETH) and sells (tokens). Buy fees accumulate in an ETH pot; every 20 swaps the pot is used to buy back tokens and distribute them via the token's `notifyReflection()` mechanism. Sell fees are sent directly to the token contract's reflection bucket. Sells are blocked in the same block as a buyback.
